desc: step(e, x) and sign(v) on run-time vec4<f32>: e = (0.5, 1, -1, 2), x = (0.5, 0.9, -0.5, 3) -> (1, 0, 1, 1); v = (-2.5, 0, 3, -0.25) -> (-1, 0, 1, -1); the third vec4 is not written (P0-DXIL-054: DXIL emitted component 0 only)

knownFailures.reason: sign() of a float is written bare; HLSL sign returns int, so dst[1] receives the bit patterns of -1, 0, 1 (NaN, 0, 1e-45)
